messages:
Mia: Quick FYI — ACME's Sr Eng (Jordan Park) is flying in tomorrow and will be on-site 9:30–11:30. He asked if we can pre-print a guest badge and set aside a hotdesk near the east window. :wave:
Gabe: @Mia I can grab the badge print at 9:10. Which desk is the east window? Hotdesks are 2–6.
Cleo: There's an empty hotdesk 4 by the east window. I'll reserve it and put a sticky 'Jordan Park — ACME' on it.
Frontdesk-Bot: Visitor pre-registered: Jordan Park — ACME Corp — arriving 2026-02-14 09:30. Temp badge will be printed. Please ensure ID shown at check-in. :id_card: 
Mailroom: Heads up — a large parcel just arrived for 'Jordan Park / ACME' on tracking `1Z999AAEXAMPLE`. It's oversized (monitor + stand). Do you want it held at mailroom or left at desk 4? :package:
Mia: Please hold at mailroom and tag it 'Jordan Park — hold till 2/14 9:00'. @Mailroom can you put a note on the package and send pic?
Mailroom: Got it. Placed in oversize locker 3. Photo sent to #people-ops (attached). Locker tag: "Jordan Park — ACME — HOLD until 2026-02-14 09:00".
Gabe: @Mailroom thanks. I'll pick it up first thing and bring it to desk 4 before 9:15.
Ryan: Small note about badges — we only ask guests to sign NDAs for product/research meetings. Jordan's meeting is with Platform, no NDA required. @Mia confirm.
Mia: Confirmed, no NDA. Standard visitor badge only. :thumbsup:
Natalie: One more — if he wants to use a meeting room after, Delmar 2 is free 11:30–12:30. I've held it tentatively.
Cleo: All set. Sticky note on desk 4, badge printed, parcel in oversize locker labelled. @Mia if you want me to leave a welcome note with water + cereal bar, I can.
Mia: That would be awesome, thanks :heart:
